meta.race: Fall Athletic Cut — Aug 31 – Oct 25, 2026. Athleticism and fat loss (260 → sub-250). Not a strength block.

calf_rules: The calf gate governs ALL impact — running, jumping, and change-of-direction. Log a calf rating after every run or jump session.
Anything above 2/10 freezes the impact ramp at its current stage — repeat, do not advance.
A flare steps the ramp back one stage.
Weeks 1–2 are the running test protocol: zero impact elsewhere, engine on the ergs. Both tests clean → Stage 2 unlocks in Week 3.

Running ramp: Stage 1 (W1–2) walk/jog intervals · Stage 2 (W3–4) continuous easy jog then 2:1 intervals · Stage 3 (W5–6) push/base tread intervals · Stage 4 (W7–8) sprint intervals and the continuous benchmark.
